description: Defines a Data Transfer Object class 'TimeAtWorkLastActionDetails' in the OrangeHRM Dashboard module, encapsulating details about the last action timestamp related to time tracking at work.

classes.name: TimeAtWorkLastActionDetails
classes.description: A DTO class that holds information about the last recorded action time, including state, UTC and user-local date/time, and timezone offset.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize all fields related to the last action details, optional parameters allow partial data.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state/status as a string or null.

methods.name: getUtcDate
methods.description: Returns the UTC date string of the last action or null.

methods.name: getUtcTime
methods.description: Returns the UTC time string of the last action or null.

methods.name: getUserDate
methods.description: Returns the user-local date string of the last action or null.

methods.name: getUserTime
methods.description: Returns the user-local time string of the last action or null.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the timezone offset string relevant to the last action or null.
